_comment: The homepage 'What's new in Ze' band, rendered by tools/render-index.py directly above the proof strip. The article and weekly-update slots are generated (newest blog/posts/*.md and newest changes/posts/*.md), so only the freeform note below is edited by hand. Keep title and body short: the band sits above the fold and the KPI cards under it must stay visible on a laptop screen. `tone` picks a presentation color without claiming the note belongs to a feature category. Drop the whole `note` object to render the band with two slots.
